entries.text: Partitioned Parquet output now fills row groups to the configured row_group_size (122,880 by default) instead of writing one small row group per input block. On 3 million rows across 200 partitions this cut the row-group count from 35,000 to 285 and conversion time from 9.1 s to 3.5 s. Partitioned output records its own writer identity, benchbox-pyarrow-partitioned, so results from the new layout get a different data_generation_hash from results produced before the fix.
